column1: # D1 stability gate: per-arm fits for the fourteen arms whose extraction was complete while
# six cells were still running, dispatched to a card that fell idle rather than held for a
# control set frozen by qualify_stability_controls.py before any model quantity was read.
# Two arms read their extraction from the earlier snapshot's results directory because their
# cells were already running when the per-card manifests were frozen; the extraction code
# differs between the two snapshots only in where one plan-validation function lives.
# Every cell here also appears in one of the per-card fit manifests, whose output directory
# is the same label under the same snapshot, so a later dispatch of those manifests records
# skipped-complete for it rather than repeating the fit.
